tailoredFor: cocktail-bar-web — client-rendered React SPA (Vite, React Router, TanStack Query)
abstract: Performance optimization guide for React applications, designed for AI agents and LLMs. This copy is a tailored fork of Vercel Engineering's React Best Practices: 58 rules across 7 categories, prioritized by impact from critical (eliminating waterfalls, reducing bundle size) to incremental (advanced patterns). The upstream server-* category and other Next.js-specific rules have been removed, and the remainder retargeted to a client-rendered SPA with no server runtime. Each rule includes an explanation, incorrect and correct examples, and the failure mode it prevents.
